# GulfDermaCare

> GulfDermaCare sells pharmaceutical-grade monobenzone cream (Monozan, by Behvazan Pharmaceutical Co.) and related depigmentation products for vitiligo patients, with worldwide shipping and a focus on the GCC region (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain).

Monobenzone is a prescription-strength topical used for permanent depigmentation in extensive vitiligo. GulfDermaCare supplies it direct to consumers and clinics with pharmaceutical documentation for customs clearance.

## Products
- [Monozan Cream](https://www.gulfdermacare.com/monozan-cream/): Monobenzone 20% cream, Iranian brand by Behvazan Pharmaceutical Co.
- [Benoquin Cream Alternative](https://www.gulfdermacare.com/benoquin-cream/): Pharmaceutical-equivalent replacement for discontinued Benoquin.
- [MBEH Cream](https://www.gulfdermacare.com/mbeh-cream/): Monobenzyl ether of hydroquinone cream.
